description: The Building Construction Technician performs a wide range of skilled construction tasks including Survey of land and performing essential tasks such as preparing construction sites, setting up foundation structures and assisting in the installation of infrastructure components like buildings, selection of construction materials, construction and maintenance of building, estimate the cost of raw materials and total construct cost.
awardingBodyName: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Explain physical properties related to motion and simple machines.
Use Technical Drawing for Building Plan.
Identify and assess different physical properties of construction materials.
Perform surveying of construction sites using traditional and modern tools and techniques.
Demonstrate activities related to building construction and provision of sanitary and electrical connection.
Use measurement book, estimate building construction costs and perform testing of construction materials.
